# NAACP Legal Defense Fund

> The NAACP Legal Defense Fund (LDF) is a premier civil rights organization fighting for racial justice through strategic litigation and advocacy since 1940.

Founded by Thurgood Marshall, the LDF focuses on criminal justice reform, police accountability, fair sentencing, and equal protection under law. The organization operates through multiple practice areas addressing systemic racial bias in the American legal system.

## Key Topics

- Criminal Justice Reform
- Police Accountability
- Capital Punishment
- Fair Sentencing
- Racial Justice
- Civil Rights Litigation
- Voting Rights
- Jury Discrimination
- Qualified Immunity
- Juvenile Life Without Parole
- Voter Suppression
- Equal Justice
- Legal Advocacy
- Thurgood Marshall
- Sherrilyn Ifill

## About the Organization

- [Legal Defense Fund Homepage](https://www.naacpldf.org): NAACP Legal Defense Fund homepage fighting for racial justice since 1940
- [Our Impact & Mission](https://www.naacpldf.org/ldf-mission): LDF mission statement on achieving racial justice and inclusive society
- [About Us](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us): Premier legal organization for civil rights advocacy and litigation
- [History](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us/history): LDF history founded by Thurgood Marshall in 1940, landmark cases
- [Meet the Staff](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us/staff): LDF staff directory including leadership team and departments

## Criminal Justice Practice

- [Criminal Justice Overview](https://www.naacpldf.org/ldf-mission/criminal-justice): LDF criminal justice work eliminating racial bias in sentencing
- [Criminal Justice Cases & Issues](https://www.naacpldf.org/our-impact/criminal-justice/cases-issues): Criminal justice cases and issues on capital punishment, policing
- [Police Accountability & Discretion Abuse](https://www.naacpldf.org/our-impact/criminal-justice/abuse-of-police-discretion): Litigation on police accountability and discretion abuse
- [Capital Punishment](https://www.naacpldf.org/our-impact/criminal-justice/capital-punishment): Capital punishment cases addressing racial bias in death penalty
- [Fair Sentencing](https://www.naacpldf.org/our-impact/criminal-justice/fair-sentencing): Fair sentencing litigation including Ramos v. Louisiana
- [Juvenile Life Without Parole](https://www.naacpldf.org/our-impact/criminal-justice/juvenile-life-without-parole): Juvenile justice advocacy against life without parole sentences
- [Police Accountability Campaign](https://www.naacpldf.org/our-impact/criminal-justice/policing-reform-campaign): Police accountability campaign challenging qualified immunity

## Careers & Educational Programs

- [Fellowships and Internships](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us/fellowships-internships): Internship and fellowship programs for civil rights law careers
- [Scholarships](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us/ldf-scholarships): Herbert Lehman and Earl Warren scholarship programs for students
- [Careers](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us/careers): Job openings in Washington D.C., Atlanta, New York, Mississippi
